notes_for_editor: The only Yellowhead-specific record found is the register entry (built 2012, steel, 30 m, active, drive access, weather station). Two web searches turned up no Yellowhead history, so the story is short. The register is the query endpoint used for ca-ab-athabasca. The brief's access 'closed' is not supported by any source read; see corrections. The brief's agency 'Alberta Wildfire' is not quoted in any source read, so the story does not name an agency. The 127-site count and the observer sentence apply to all Alberta sites, not to Yellowhead alone; the story says so.
